concept.interaction: Hold carrier in palm. One finger presses leaf lower-tip pad tangentially to rotate75 degrees; press its newly exposed return pad in the opposite direction to close to0 degrees. Alternating press pads, no same-button latch. Pin retains leaf. Open leaf, release cover and insert or remove inlay along Z.
concept.materials: Unfilled PETG for four printed components; fixed owner-supplied PET NFC inlay.
concept.mechanical_definition: Direct input and moving crescent are the same rigid leaf. Alternate tangential finger presses move it0→75→0 degrees. No spring or same-button toggle. Hard track endpoints limit travel; no claimed measured click or detent.

nfc.tap_landmark: Underside recessed V frame,17.5 by27.5 outer opening around15.5 by25.5 flat landing; depth0.8 mm; window remains1.0 mm.

novel_mechanisms.definition: A direct finger-driven off-centre revolute crescent leaf nests above a fixed crescent at zero degrees and opens75 degrees into a two-wing fan; alternating tangential press pads return it, with mechanical endpoint stops and captured revolute pivot and hard stops.

concept.print_stance: Print broad crescent and lid faces flat; print pivot head down with the modeled support-free barb ramps.
risks: Elastic pin and cover release are supported by clearance and strain estimates only; actual print fit, force and service life are untested.
No guaranteed unattended state retention: the owner operates the leaf between hard stops.
concept.signature_interaction: One-finger alternating presses change a nested crescent into a lunar fan and restore it.
concept.summary: Press a crescent into an open lunar fan, then press its return pad to nest it back into the moon; a removable owner-supplied NFC inlay rests behind the thumb-findable underside window.
concept.title: Moon Fan

design_decisions: Direct alternating press pads chosen to avoid an unproved push-push cam.
Coil-first rigid pocket in fixed crescent belly, hardware-free nonconductive construction.
All force/cycle and RF numbers are targets until physical measurement.

claims: User requires one-finger press shape change and press return to crescent moon.
Clauses1–4 fix inlay, FDM pocket allowance, window and keep-out. Clauses5–7 and9 govern materials, loads and service.
Reachable catalog returned no matching candidate; choose custom printed pivot, not a supplier placeholder.
